image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a silver alloy car wheel mounted on a white vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke design with a central Honda logo hubcap. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall texture. The brake caliper and rotor are partially visible through the spokes. The lighting creates realistic metallic reflections on the rim.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy class and verify the object is indeed a car wheel and not a similar circular object.
To ensure there is no 'melting' or boundary bleeding between the metal rim and the rubber tire, a common AI artifact.
To verify that the spaces between spokes reveal a physically consistent depth for the brake caliper and rotor behind them.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the metal reflections or rubber grain that might indicate generative artifacts.

focus_areas: Integrity of the circular silhouette (no warping)
Clarity and physical correctness of the bolt hole pattern
Boundary sharpness between rim and tire
Realism of metallic reflections on the alloy spokes
Depth consistency of the brake components visible through spokes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the spokes and the lug nut holes. AI generators often struggle with perfect rotational symmetry and consistent hole counts. Also, verify that the Honda logo is structurally coherent and not morphed into gibberish.
